closureNotes: Start from the closure-attempt-1 board (39 unconnected; its closure notes are in route_report.md 'closure' section and summarised here). NEW PM RULINGS (brief §12 F13, already in tools/pcb/attachment_check.py): (1) U200 ESCAPES: add a constraint-only rule area (pcbnew ZONE with SetIsRuleArea(True), no keepouts, name 'EMU_FANOUT', all copper layers) covering x 266.5-280.0 / y 88.0-101.5, and append to the board's .kicad_dru: (rule "emu_fanout" (condition "A.intersectsArea('EMU_FANOUT') && B.intersectsArea('EMU_FANOUT')") (constraint clearance (min 0.127mm))) and (rule "emu_fanout_via" (condition "A.Type == 'Via' && A.intersectsArea('EMU_FANOUT')") (constraint annular_width (min 0.10mm)) (constraint via_diameter (min 0.40mm)) (constraint hole_size (min 0.20mm))). Verify with kicad-cli DRC that a 0.40/0.20 via and 0.127 mm spacing inside the area report no violation while the rest of the board keeps 0.20 (put a deliberate test via/track in, DRC, remove). Then re-fan U200 with exact-polygon fan-out (your fanout.py): two staggered via rows of 0.40/0.20 at alternate lands (row 1 ≈ 0.55 mm and row 2 ≈ 1.25 mm from the land tips, hole-to-hole ≥ 0.5 mm), 0.127 mm tracks from the row-2 lands passing between the row-1 vias (0.40 mm gap vs 0.381 mm needed - construct, do not search), escape onto In2 (the panel's In2 population) and B.Cu; keep the caps where they are (they were measured not to be the binding constraint). (2) The 9 GND lands: connect each INWARD on F.Cu to U200's exposed pad (net GND, 3.4 x 3.4 mm with 9 thermal vias, 1.3 mm gap from the land inner end) with a 0.127-0.2 mm radial track - no via needed; this is how the flown FC's U18 does it. (3) ALLOWED_PADS now gives J1 pin 6 (F4_SDA) 20 mm and U6 pin 6 (Deploy2_EN) 24 mm: route F4_SDA by the F12 tap along the measured 17.9 mm path south around J1/J2, and Deploy2_EN from its F12 via tap at (173.500,130.100) out through the x 178.7-182 corridor (both were measured feasible in attempt 1). (4) The 5 isolated islands of the GND_F_Cu_wing pour: find them with pcbnew (fill with islands kept, then list each filled polygon not connected to the plane via CONNECTIVITY_DATA or by testing each polygon for a via/pad) and drop one 0.46/0.20 GND stitching via in each. (5) The U6.1-U6.29 unconnected item is between two heritage pads on the FC (pre-existing, present on Rev2): leave it, list it as the FC baseline. (6) Deliver with heritage.py --refill --core-inset 12 --ref-board (0 violations), attachment_check (0), DRC with parity inside the project directory. Target: 0 unconnected. If anything remains, name it with the exact geometric reason and the smallest rule change that would close it.
